optimizer_updates_per_logical_step.ema: before step750 every step; at/after step750 iff Generator updates

micro_wave: send detached x_fake to paired Score rank
Score computes official DMD + GAN-G and returns dL/dx_fake
G applies returned latent gradient and accumulates local parameter gradients
after_two_waves: same eight Score ranks become trainable Critic ranks without moving the 14B backbone

critic_step.logical_step_commit: after both micro-waves, exactly one Critic optimizer/scheduler update
critic_step.ema: after Critic commit only when official EMA predicate is true; for steps1000-1004 only step1000

memory_policy.frozen_block_set: load measured-minimum GAN block-offload result; never infer from No-GAN
memory_policy.activation_offload: same frozen Generator-selected policy as matched GAN baseline
memory_policy.prefetch: off until correctness; add only after matched pipeline PASS
memory_policy.memory_failure: actual CUDA/cgroup OOM or memory-attributed nonzero exit

claim_boundary: prototype scheduling contract only until a real world16 execution proves tensor/loss/version/optimizer/EMA parity against the official GAN Route-A baseline
